mapper.select: select d.dept_id, d.dept_title, n.national_name as location_name, count(e.emp_id) as emp_count, round(avg(e.salary)) as avg_salary from dept d left join location l on d.location_id = l.local_code left join national n on l.national_code = n.national_code left join emp e on e.dept_id = d.dept_id and e.ent_yn = 'N' group by d.dept_id, d.dept_title, n.national_name order by d.dept_id
mapper.insert: insert into dept (dept_id, dept_title, location_id) values (#{deptId}, #{deptTitle}, #{locationId})
